# PRIMET

> PRIMET (SIA Primet) is a Latvian manufacturer of custom industrial equipment for food processing, cosmetics, pharmaceutical production and metalworking. We design, fabricate, install and service stainless steel (AISI 304/316) machinery and complete production lines, built to order. 300+ projects across Latvia and the Baltics since 2015.

Key facts:
- Location: Krustpils iela 4, Riga, LV-1073, Latvia
- Contact: info@primet.lv, +371 2 9252149
- Materials: food-grade AISI 304 / 316 stainless steel; washdown-ready, HACCP/GMP compliant
- Model: custom engineering to order — design, fabrication, installation, operator training, on-site service
- Industries: fish, meat, dairy, vegetables & berries, cosmetics, pharmaceutical, metalworking
- Languages: Latvian (/lv), English (/en), Russian (/ru)
